final: WITH per AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost <= 20.99 AND rating IS NOT NULL AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration <> 0 GROUP BY rating), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM per) SELECT per.rating, per.avg_ratio, per.avg_ratio - m.overall_mean AS above_overall_mean FROM per, m WHERE per.avg_ratio > m.overall_mean ORDER BY per.rating
